item.summary: rework a transaction restart for OST

status.description: The issue is open and ready for the assignee to start work on it.

comments.comment: undo in ext4 means modification of same blocks usually which doesn't need extra credits.

ldiskfs_fsblk_t ldiskfs_mb_new_blocks(handle_t *handle,
...
out:
        if (inquota && ar->len < inquota)
                dquot_free_block(ar->inode, LDISKFS_C2B(sbi, inquota - ar->len)); << ar->len == 0

and quota tries to update a quota file - it needs a credits..
ldiskfs_write_dquot ..

..
        handle = ldiskfs_journal_start(inode, LDISKFS_HT_QUOTA,
                                    LDISKFS_QUOTA_TRANS_BLOCKS(dquot->dq_sb));
        if (IS_ERR(handle))
                return PTR_ERR(handle);
        ret = dquot_commit(dquot);
        if (ret < 0)
                ldiskfs_error_err(dquot->dq_sb, -ret,
                               "Failed to commit dquot type %d",
                               dquot->dq_id.type);

>>
[4749461.333092] LDISKFS-fs error (device md1) in ldiskfs_write_dquot:6893: error 28
>>

yes, I understand we many need to undo changes. but undo implies you did something before in this transaction and those blocks are part of the transaction already, so any new modification shouldn't need extra credit.
ldiskfs_journal_start() should get into the same transaction also, AFAIK.

it looks like should be it's not a true in real. it's better to check current transaction have an enough space before map blocks.

               if (handle && check_credits) {
                        struct osd_thandle *oh;
                        int credits;

                        LASSERT(thandle != NULL);
                        oh = container_of(thandle, struct osd_thandle,
                                          ot_super);
                        /*
                         * only issue IO if restart transaction needed,
                         * as update disk size need hold inode lock, we
                         * want to avoid that as much as possible.
                         */
                        credits = ldiskfs_chunk_trans_blocks(inode, map.m_len);
                        if (CFS_FAIL_CHECK(OBD_FAIL_OST_RESTART_IO) ||
                           (osd_extend_trans(handle, credits, inode))) {
                                rc = osd_ldiskfs_map_write(inode,
                                        iobuf, osd, start_blocks,
                                        count, &disk_size, user_size);
                                if (rc)
                                        GOTO(cleanup, rc);
                                thandle->th_restart_tran = 1;
                                iobuf->dr_start_pg_wblks = (start_blocks +
                                                count) % blocks_per_page;
                                GOTO(cleanup, rc = -EAGAIN);
                        }
                }

I think it have problem with credits for something other than mapping blocks, but it problem still exist now. It probably we needs to account a number extra credits and adjust osd_extend_trans argument.
